records.source: Oh... you're that new farmer boy, aren't you?^Oh... You're that new farmer girl, or whatever. Aren't you?#$e#Huh? Oh... I'm Haley.#$e#Hmm... If it weren't for those horrendous clothes you might actually be cute.^Hmm... If it weren't for those horrendous clothes you might actually be pretty... Actually, never mind.$h
records.translation: Ah... ikaw ang bagong magsasakang lalaki, hindi ba?^Ah... Ikaw ang bagong babaeng magsasaka o ano. Hindi ba?#$e#Huh? Ah... Ako si Haley.#$e#Hmm... Kung hindi lang dahil sa nakapanghihilakbot mong mga damit, baka guwapo ka talaga.^Hmm... Kung hindi lang dahil sa nakapanghihilakbot mong mga damit, baka maganda ka talaga... Huwag na pala.$h

records.source: Oh... you want to dance with *me*, do you?$13^Oh? Sure! I'll dance with you!#$b#Hehe... of course. I'd love to be your partner.$h^We'll have a great time!$h#$e#Hmm... I admire your confidence. Most guys are too shy to ask me.^You look so pretty today!$h
records.translation: Ah... gusto mong makipagsayaw sa *akin*, ano?$13^Ah? Sige! Sasayaw ako kasama mo!#$b#Hehe... siyempre. Gustung-gusto kong maging kapareha mo.$h^Magiging napakasaya natin!$h#$e#Hmm... Hinahangaan ko ang tiwala mo sa sarili. Masyadong mahiyain ang karamihan sa mga lalaki upang yayain ako.^Napakaganda mo ngayon!$h

records.source: *gasp*... You got this for me? Wow, @, this is the best birthday gift ever!$h
records.translation: *napasinghap*... Binili mo ito para sa akin? Wow, @, ito ang pinakamagandang regalo sa kaarawan!$h

records.source: Awwwww, you got me a birthday gift? Well, I really like it!$h
records.translation: Awwwww, binigyan mo ako ng regalo sa kaarawan? Aba, talagang gusto ko ito!$h

records.source: Gross! You got me this on my birthday? What's wrong with you!$a
records.translation: Kadiri! Ibinigay mo ito sa akin sa kaarawan ko? Ano ang problema mo!$a

records.source: For me? Ooooh... I can't decide if I should drink it, or use it as shampoo...
records.translation: Para sa akin? Ooooh... Hindi ako makapagpasiya kung iinumin ko ito o gagamiting shampoo...

records.source: $c 0.8#Is that... coconut? I love this!$h#Mmm.... coconuts remind me of warm, sunny days at the beach. When I hold one, I feel like I'm there... even when it's raining.
records.translation: $c 0.8#Niyog ba iyan? Gustung-gusto ko ito!$h#Mmm.... Ipinapaalala sa akin ng mga niyog ang maiinit at maaraw na araw sa dalampasigan. Kapag may hawak ako nito, pakiramdam ko'y naroon ako... kahit umuulan.

records.source: Wow, they're beautiful! These are my absolute favorite.$h
records.translation: Wow, napakaganda nila! Ang mga ito ang talagang paborito ko.$h

records.source: I don't think I've ever set foot in this place. It's actually kind of cozy!$h#$e#Oh, I'm not worried about the rain. I'm sure it'll pass.
records.translation: Sa tingin ko'y hindi pa ako nakatuntong sa lugar na ito. Medyo maginhawa pala rito!$h#$e#Ah, hindi ako nag-aalala sa ulan. Sigurado akong lilipas din ito.

records.source: Wake me up when there's a pink rain... Or better yet, a pink cake rain!
records.translation: Gisingin mo ako kapag may kulay-rosas na ulan... O mas mabuti, ulan ng kulay-rosas na keyk!

records.source: It was fun taking pictures, but I had to shower for two hours to get the mud out of my hair!$h
records.translation: Masaya ang pagkuha ng mga litrato, pero kinailangan kong maligo nang dalawang oras upang alisin ang putik sa buhok ko!$h

records.source: %Haley greets you with a smile. You notice that she's wearing her Great-Grandma's bracelet.
records.translation: %Ngumingiting binati ka ni Haley. Napansin mong suot niya ang pulseras ng kaniyang lola sa tuhod.

records.source: Wow, looks like someone's read the latest issue of 'Super Fashion Girl'... muddy boots are totally in right now!$h
records.translation: Wow, mukhang may nakabasa ng pinakabagong isyu ng “Super Moda na Dalaga”... usong-uso ngayon ang maputik na bota!$h

records.source: My parents sent another postcard... I guess they're in the middle of a cruise down the Gem Sea Coast.#$e#They said me and Emily could join them at any point, but let's be honest... who wants to go on vacation with their parents?
records.translation: Nagpadala na naman ng postcard ang mga magulang ko... Mukhang nasa kalagitnaan sila ng paglalayag sa baybayin ng Dagat ng Gem.#$e#Sinabi nilang maaari kaming sumama sa kanila ni Emily anumang oras, pero maging tapat tayo... sino ang gustong magbakasyon kasama ang mga magulang nila?

records.source: The other day, Emily baked something called a 'squirrel loaf'...$u#$e#How'd it taste? Um... well, if my tail was a little bushier I probably would've loved it.$h
records.translation: Noong isang araw ay naghurno si Emily ng tinatawag na “tinapay ng ardilya”...$u#$e#Ano ang lasa? Um... aba, kung mas mabuhok nang kaunti ang buntot ko, malamang ay gustung-gusto ko iyon.$h

records.source: Did you see last night's episode of 'Tears'? *sob*... I can't believe Kyle and Amy broke up...$s
records.translation: Napanood mo ba ang episode kagabi ng “Mga Luha”? *hikbi*... Hindi ako makapaniwalang naghiwalay sina Kyle at Amy...$s

records.source: My name means 'field of hay', but I like to imagine it as a meadow full of sunflowers...
records.translation: Ang ibig sabihin ng pangalan ko ay “bukid ng dayami”, pero gusto kong isipin iyon bilang isang parang na punô ng mga mirasol...

records.source: I was waiting for you to ask me that.$l
records.translation: Hinihintay kong itanong mo iyan.$l

records.source: You look really handsome today.$l^You look really pretty today.$l
records.translation: Napakaguwapo mo ngayon.$l^Napakaganda mo ngayon.$l

records.source: Well, I guess this makes you my 'brother-in-law', huh? That's funny to think about.^Hey, I guess we're kind of like sisters now!$h
records.translation: Aba, siguro ay bayaw na kita, ha? Nakakatawang isipin iyon.^Hoy, parang magkapatid na babae na tayo ngayon!$h

records.source: Things didn't work out between you and Emily, huh? Well... It happens.#$e#It *is* kind of awkward that you're both still living in this tiny town, though.
records.translation: Hindi naging maayos ang pagsasama ninyo ni Emily, ha? Aba... Nangyayari iyon.#$e#Pero medyo asiwa dahil pareho pa rin kayong nakatira sa munting bayang ito.

records.source: So, what's the idea here... am I just going to be your 'girlfriend' forever...?$7
records.translation: Kung gayon, ano ba ang balak dito... magiging “kasintahan” mo lang ba ako magpakailanman...?$7

records.source: Is Emily settling into the farm life?#$e#You know, I was starting to wonder if Emily would ever get married...
records.translation: Nasasanay na ba si Emily sa buhay sa bukid?#$e#Alam mo, nagsisimula na akong mag-isip kung mag-aasawa pa ba si Emily...

records.source: I saw a dolphin on the way in!
records.translation: Nakakita ako ng lumba-lumba habang papunta rito!

records.source: There's something about the sun that just makes me feel good.
records.translation: May kakaiba sa sikat ng araw na talagang nagpapasaya sa akin.

records.source: It's strange the places life can take you... who knows what other lands are out there?
records.translation: Kakaiba ang mga lugar na maaari mong marating sa buhay... sino ang nakaaalam kung ano pang mga lupain ang naroroon?

records.source: Wow, look at how the sunlight sparkles on the horizon!$h#$b#I bet the sunsets here would make for an amazing photo.#$e#I have to remember to bring my camera next time.
records.translation: Wow, tingnan mo kung paano kumikislap ang sikat ng araw sa abot-tanaw!$h#$b#Siguradong magiging kahanga-hangang litrato ang mga paglubog ng araw dito.#$e#Kailangan kong tandaang dalhin ang kamera ko sa susunod.

records.source: Getting the perfect tan is an art form...#$e#It's kind of like toasting a marshmallow... you have to rotate the body just right.$h
records.translation: Isang anyo ng sining ang pagkakaroon ng perpektong pagkakaitim ng balat...#$e#Parang pag-iihaw iyon ng marshmallow... kailangan mong paikutin ang katawan nang tama.$h

records.source: Laying out on a tropical beach.#$b#*sigh* I think I've finally found my place in the universe.#$e#But I guess Stardew Valley's not such a bad place either!$h
records.translation: Nakahiga sa isang tropikal na dalampasigan.#$b#*buntong-hininga* Sa tingin ko'y natagpuan ko na sa wakas ang lugar ko sa sansinukob.#$e#Pero siguro ay hindi rin naman ganoon kasama ang Stardew Valley!$h

records.source: Emily's friend had this swimsuit shipped to me from all the way out in Zuzu City.#$e#City fashion is on a whole different level, isn't it?$h
records.translation: Ipinadala sa akin ng kaibigan ni Emily ang kasuotang panligong ito mula pa sa Lungsod ng Zuzu.#$e#Nasa ibang antas talaga ang moda sa lungsod, hindi ba?$h

records.source: I painted my toenails blue to match the sea. What do you think? *wiggle* *wiggle*$h
records.translation: Pininturahan ko ng asul ang mga kuko sa paa ko upang bumagay sa dagat. Ano sa palagay mo? *kislot* *kislot*$h

records.source: Gus made a cute, fruity drink just for me!$h
records.translation: Gumawa si Gus ng nakatutuwang inuming may prutas para lang sa akin!$h

records.source: This is such a perfect beach. I'd stay here forever if I could!
records.translation: Napakaperpekto ng dalampasigang ito. Mananatili sana ako rito magpakailanman kung maaari!

records.source: *sigh*... My days of being Flower Queen are over... so it's a bittersweet dance for me.$s#$b#But, yes...
records.translation: *buntong-hininga*... Tapos na ang mga araw ko bilang Reyna ng mga Bulaklak... kaya may tamis at pait ang sayaw na ito para sa akin.$s#$b#Pero, oo...

records.source: Ew... No.
records.translation: Kadiri... Hindi.

records.source: I'll be fine on my own...$7#$e#Thanks for the memories.$7#$e#Why are you still clinging to me? Go live your own life.$7
records.translation: Magiging maayos ako nang mag-isa...$7#$e#Salamat sa mga alaala.$7#$e#Bakit kumakapit ka pa rin sa akin? Mamuhay ka ng sarili mong buhay.$7

records.source: Agh!$8#$b#Oh... hmph. Beat me to it, huh? Alright...
records.translation: Agh!$8#$b#Ah... hmph. Naunahan mo ako, ha? Sige...

records.source: I've got nothing to say to you!$a
records.translation: Wala akong sasabihin sa iyo!$a

records.source: Alright, alright... I'm done giving you the cold shoulder. Just promise me you'll never, ever lie to me again.$s
records.translation: Sige, sige... Tapos na ako sa pag-iwas sa iyo. Ipangako mo lang na hindi ka na kailanman magsisinungaling sa akin.$s

records.source: This town is so small. It sucks.$u#$e#I have to drive, like, twenty miles to buy any decent clothes.$s#$e#That's why I usually just order online.#$e#What?
records.translation: Napakaliit ng bayang ito. Pangit dito.$u#$e#Kailangan kong magmaneho nang mga dalawampung milya upang bumili ng anumang matinong damit.$s#$e#Kaya karaniwan ay umoorder na lang ako sa internet.#$e#Ano?

records.source: Nice shoes.^Nice makeup.#$b#Are those made out of plastic?^Or wait... Are you even wearing any?#$e#I'm bored.
records.translation: Maganda ang sapatos mo.^Maganda ang makeup mo.#$b#Gawa ba sa plastik ang mga iyan?^O teka... May makeup ka ba talaga?#$e#Nababagot ako.

records.source: The only thing I like about this town is the beach.$u
records.translation: Dalampasigan lang ang gusto ko sa bayang ito.$u

records.source: #$1 HaleyClothes#I've decided I am going to organize my clothes today. I'll have to throw out all of last year's styles to make room for the new ones!#$e#*sigh* I could really go for a cupcake right now.#$e#Do you need something?
records.translation: #$1 HaleyClothes#Nagpasiya akong ayusin ang mga damit ko ngayon. Kailangan kong itapon ang lahat ng estilo noong nakaraang taon upang magkaroon ng puwang para sa mga bago!#$e#*buntong-hininga* Gusto ko talaga ng munting keyk ngayon.#$e#May kailangan ka ba?

records.source: %Haley is ignoring you.
records.translation: %Hindi ka pinapansin ni Haley.

records.source: Don't you get tired of running around on that farm all day, or whatever it is you do?#$e#I couldn't stand getting all dirty like that.#$e#You probably get a nice tan, though.
records.translation: Hindi ka ba napapagod sa maghapong paroo't parito sa bukid o anumang ginagawa mo?#$e#Hindi ko kayang maging marumi nang ganoon.#$e#Pero malamang ay gumaganda ang pagkakaitim ng balat mo.

records.source: I'm feeling an urge to go shopping. Ugh! I wish there was a mall here.
records.translation: Gustong-gusto kong mamili. Ugh! Sana ay may sentro ng pamilihan dito.

records.source: My sister is so weird. Sometimes I wonder if we're actually related.$u
records.translation: Talagang kakaiba ang kapatid ko. Minsan ay iniisip ko kung tunay ba kaming magkadugo.$u

records.source: There are only two things I like about this town.#$b#One of them is the beach.#$e#The other one is a secret! *giggle*$h
records.translation: Dalawa lang ang gusto ko sa bayang ito.#$b#Isa roon ang dalampasigan.#$e#Lihim ang isa pa! *hagikgik*$h

records.source: I wonder if any nice shells washed up on the beach this morning?#$e#This isn't the best time of year for shells, though.
records.translation: May magagandang kabibe kayang naanod sa dalampasigan kaninang umaga?#$e#Pero hindi ito ang pinakamagandang panahon ng taon para sa mga kabibe.

records.source: I'm glad that the flowers are starting to bloom.#$e#Those pink ones smell so good.$h
records.translation: Natutuwa akong nagsisimula nang mamukadkad ang mga bulaklak.#$e#Napakabango ng mga kulay-rosas na bulaklak.$h

records.source: I need to find some kind of hobby other than shopping.#$e#I've decided I want to expand my horizons.#$e#Maybe I should learn to play the mini-harp?
records.translation: Kailangan kong humanap ng libangan bukod sa pamimili.#$e#Nagpasiya akong palawakin ang mga karanasan ko.#$e#Baka dapat akong matutong tumugtog ng maliit na alpa?

records.source: I used to complain about this town being so small, but I've grown to like it.#$e#If it was much bigger it wouldn't feel like a community.
records.translation: Dati akong nagrereklamo na napakaliit ng bayang ito, pero nagustuhan ko na ito.#$e#Kung mas malaki pa ito, hindi ito magiging parang isang komunidad.

records.source: I cooked dinner last night. It actually turned out okay!#$e#But I did make a huge mess in the kitchen...
records.translation: Nagluto ako ng hapunan kagabi. Naging maayos naman pala!#$e#Pero napakalaki ng ginawa kong kalat sa kusina...

records.source: I'm thinking about donating a bunch of clothes... I must have a hundred pairs of shoes.
records.translation: Iniisip kong ipamigay ang maraming damit... Siguro ay mayroon akong isang daang pares ng sapatos.

records.source: #$1 haleySeagull#Yesterday I found a seagull with her wing caught in a net. I set her free, of course. She looked so helpless, the poor thing.$k$s#$e#You know, I should probably start exercising more... this youthful metabolism won't last forever.
records.translation: #$1 haleySeagull#Kahapon ay nakakita ako ng babaeng tagak-dagat na naipit ang pakpak sa lambat. Siyempre ay pinalaya ko siya. Mukha siyang walang kalaban-laban, kawawa naman.$k$s#$e#Alam mo, baka dapat akong magsimulang mag-ehersisyo nang mas madalas... hindi magtatagal magpakailanman ang mabilis na metabolismo ko habang bata.

records.source: @, can we go on a camping trip someday?#$e#The most exotic place I've been is Zuzu city.
records.translation: @, maaari ba tayong magkamping balang araw?#$e#Lungsod ng Zuzu ang pinakaeksotikong lugar na napuntahan ko.

records.source: *sigh*...$u
records.translation: *buntong-hininga*...$u

records.source: NO!! I'm not going to do it!$a#$b#You guys are both stupid!%fork$a
records.translation: HINDI!! Hindi ko gagawin iyon!$a#$b#Pareho kayong hangal!%fork$a

records.source: She should take the 'high road'? What's that supposed to mean?$u#$b#You think I'm being a baby, huh?%fork$a
records.translation: Siya ang dapat “umunawa at magparaya”? Ano ang ibig sabihin niyan?$u#$b#Sa tingin mo'y nagpapakasanggol ako, ha?%fork$a

records.source: Great, then you shouldn't have any problem opening this jar for me!$h
records.translation: Ayos, kung gayon ay wala kang magiging problema sa pagbubukas ng garapong ito para sa akin!$h

records.source: Oh... you aren't? Hmmm...$s#$b#Well could you try opening this jar for me anyways?
records.translation: Ah... hindi ka ganoon? Hmmm...$s#$b#Aba, maaari mo pa ring subukang buksan ang garapong ito para sa akin?

records.source: Aw, thanks!$h
records.translation: Aw, salamat!$h

records.source: Oh! I thought you knew.#$b#This room's for developing photos.
records.translation: Ah! Akala ko ay alam mo.#$b#Para sa pagproseso ng mga litrato ang silid na ito.

records.source: Is that so...?$s
records.translation: Ganoon ba...?$s

records.source: Aw, thanks!$h
records.translation: Aw, salamat!$h
